originalTitle: S&P 500 Positive Profit Surprises Trending Above 5-Year Average
summary: With earnings season progressing, some 86% of S&P 500 companies have reported a positive profit-per-share surprise for the quarter, which is above the five-year average of 78%, according to John Butters, a senior earnings analyst from FactSet. S&P 500 companies are exceeding their earning per share estimates for the second quarter by 29.2% in aggregate, which is above the five-year average of 7%, FactSet found. The blended earnings growth rate for the quarter, which includes actual earnings and estimates for the index constituents is 50.4%, the highest growth rate since the second quarter 2021's 91.6%.

chineseTitle: 标准普尔 500 指数盈利意外高于 5 年平均水平
chineseSummary: FactSet 高级盈利分析师约翰·巴特斯 (John Butters) 表示，随着财报季的临近，约 86% 的标准普尔 500 指数公司报告本季度每股利润出现意外增长，高于 78% 的五年平均水平。 FactSet 发现，标普 500 指数公司第二季度每股收益总计超出预期 29.2%，高于 7% 的五年平均水平。该季度的综合盈利增长率（包括实际盈利和指数成分股的预测）为 50.4%，这是自 2021 年第二季度 91.6% 以来的最高增长率。
